entities.summary: Ottoman, a notable figure in the history of Bosnia and Herzegovina, associated with Medieval Bosnian Kingdom (1322–1463). Preceded by Bosnian Kingdom and Tvrtko I and Ban Kulin's abjuration of heresy under papal pressure. Their legacy influenced Ottoman conquest of Bosnia; last Bosnian King Stefan Tomašević executed.
